classification.difficultyReason: Identify solids produced by rotation and decompose the hexagon's solid into a cylinder and two cones.

children.label: a
children.prompt: The rectangle $ABCD$ is rotated about the side $AB$. Find the volume of the solid defined by this rotation.

spec.description: Rectangle with the original vertex order and dimensions. Decorative pale blue fill is omitted under house style.
spec.mathematics: AB=4 cm, BC=2 cm; rotation is about AB.
spec.answerVisibility: Givens only; the resulting cylinder and its volume are not shown.

answer.worked:
The solid is a cylinder with radius $2\text{ cm}$ and height $4\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}V&=\pi r^2h\\V&=\pi\times2^2\times4\\V&=16\pi\text{ cm}^3.\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: Triangle $ABC$ is rotated about the side $AB$. Find the volume of the solid defined by this rotation.

spec.description: Triangle with horizontal AB and vertical AC as pictured. No right-angle marker is added. Decorative pale blue fill is omitted.
spec.mathematics: AB=4 cm, AC=2 cm; rotation is about AB. Perpendicularity is pictured but not explicitly marked or stated.
spec.answerVisibility: Original givens only; no cone or volume is supplied.

answer.short: $\dfrac{16\pi}{3}\text{ cm}^3$, using the pictured right angle at $A$.
answer.worked:
Using the pictured perpendicular sides at $A$, the solid is a cone with radius $2\text{ cm}$ and height $4\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}V&=\frac13\pi r^2h\\V&=\frac13\pi\times2^2\times4\\V&=\frac{16\pi}{3}\text{ cm}^3.\end{align*}$$

children.label: c
children.prompt: A circle of radius $2\text{ cm}$ is rotated about a diameter. Find the volume of the solid defined by this rotation.

answer.worked:
The solid is a sphere with radius $2\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}V&=\frac43\pi r^3\\V&=\frac43\pi\times2^3\\V&=\frac{32\pi}{3}\text{ cm}^3.\end{align*}$$

children.label: d
children.prompt: A regular hexagon with side length $2\text{ cm}$ is rotated about the diagonal $AB$. Find the volume of the solid produced.

spec.description: Unfilled regular hexagon with horizontal upper and lower sides and the opposite-vertex diagonal AB.
spec.mathematics: Each side is 2 cm. A is the upper-left vertex and B the lower-right vertex; AB is the rotation axis.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source vertex labels and the rotation diagonal are shown.

answer.short:
$8\pi\text{ cm}^3$.

The solid consists of a cylinder and two identical cones.
answer.worked:
A regular hexagon of side $2\text{ cm}$ consists of six equilateral triangles of side $2\text{ cm}$. Along the axis $AB$, the rotated solid consists of a cylinder of height $2\text{ cm}$ and two cones, each of height $1\text{ cm}$. Their common radius is the altitude of one equilateral triangle.
$$\begin{align*}r^2&=2^2-1^2\\r^2&=3\\r&=\sqrt3\text{ cm}.\end{align*}$$
Adding the three volumes,
$$\begin{align*}V&=\pi r^2(2)+2\left(\frac13\pi r^2(1)\right)\\V&=\pi\times3\times2+2\left(\frac13\pi\times3\times1\right)\\V&=6\pi+2\pi\\V&=8\pi\text{ cm}^3.\end{align*}$$
